turns.content: I started running again after a two-year break. Did 5K this morning and my legs are destroyed.
Welcome back to running! DOMS after a long break is brutal. How did the 5K feel otherwise?
Surprisingly okay cardiovascularly. My lungs held up better than I expected.
Cardio comes back faster than leg strength. Are you following a structured plan or just going by feel?
By feel for now. I want to build up to a 10K by the end of the summer.
Plenty of time for that. The main thing at this stage is not ramping up too fast. How often are you planning to run?
Three times a week. Maybe a longer run at weekends once I build a base.
That's a sensible approach. Strength training on the off days will help protect your knees too.
